facts.title: datasette-agent 0.4a0
facts.event_hint: datasette-agent 0.4a0 增加 browser_task 浏览器内工具执行机制
facts.problem: Agent 插件需要在用户浏览器中执行定制 JavaScript，以便直接检查或调试用户当前页面和应用；此前缺少统一的浏览器任务接口。
facts.mechanism: datasette-agent 0.4a0 新增 await context.browser_task()，允许 Agent 工具把代码直接发到用户浏览器执行；作者将该机制用于 datasette-apps 0.2a0 的调试循环。

evidence.claim: 新增 await context.browser_task() 机制，使 Agent 工具能够直接在用户浏览器运行代码。
该能力允许 Datasette Agent 插件执行自定义 JavaScript。
作者用 browser_task() 为 datasette-apps 0.2a0 增加调试循环。

facts.evaluation_context: Simon Willison 的 datasette-agent 0.4a0 发布说明；没有报告浏览器任务延迟、调用次数、成功率或安全隔离指标。
facts.limitations: B 级作者发布说明，功能描述未覆盖用户授权、跨域限制、恶意 JavaScript 和浏览器状态一致性；不能据此推断 Agent 端到端性能收益。
facts.project_relevance: browser_task() 可把邮件/网页产物的局部 DOM 检查变成 Agent 工具，但必须明确用户授权、脚本白名单和只读边界，并把浏览器执行结果记录为验收证据。
source_notes: 来源为作者项目发布博客，source_level B。
证据限于接口和用途描述。

facts.title: datasette-agent 0.4a0
facts.event_hint: datasette-agent 0.4a0 adds browser_task for plugin tools to execute JavaScript in the user's browser
facts.problem: Datasette Agent plugins need a tool boundary for running browser-side code so they can inspect or debug web applications rather than relying only on server-side responses.
facts.mechanism: The release adds an await context.browser_task() mechanism that lets agent tools execute custom JavaScript directly in the user's browser. The announcement says this capability is used by datasette-apps 0.2a0 to implement an app-debug loop.

evidence.claim: datasette-agent 0.4a0 adds await context.browser_task() for agent tools to run code directly in the user's browser.
evidence.condition: Release capability described in Simon Willison's Weblog.

evidence.claim: The author reports using browser_task() to add a debug loop to datasette-apps 0.2a0.
evidence.condition: Integration example; no benchmark or security evaluation is reported.

facts.evaluation_context: The only fetched source is a B-level release announcement. It documents one new browser-execution mechanism and its use by datasette-apps, but provides no measurements of latency, tool-call count, test success, browser isolation, permission enforcement, or deployment scale.
facts.limitations: The input URL is a secondary weblog announcement rather than the GitHub release or implementation source, so primary_source_resolved is false. The post does not specify the browser sandbox, origin boundaries, user-consent flow, failure handling, or security guarantees for custom JavaScript. Claims beyond the stated capability require inspecting datasette-agent 0.4a0 and its plugin implementation.
facts.project_relevance: Browser_task illustrates a tool-chain extension that can move UI inspection and debugging into the agent's executable environment. It could support machine-checkable browser observations, but no evidence shows reduced Read/Grep/tool calls, lower latency, or improved coding-agent success.
source_notes: B-level Simon Willison's Weblog source fetched successfully; linked GitHub release and implementation were not fetched in this task.
No numeric evidence was invented because the announcement reports a capability only.
